title: Whole-operation writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Exercise direct public writer entry points for generated LINE, 3DLINE, RAY, XLINE, SOLID, TRACE, 3DFACE, LIGHT, CAMERA-to-VIEW and standalone VIEW/UCS/APPID/VPORT and a custom LAYER/entity reference, plain/embedded-MTEXT GEOPOSITIONMARKER, variable-vertex SECTIONOBJECT, MPOLYGON, VIEWPORT, OLE2FRAME, OLEFRAME, SHAPE, RASTERVARIABLES, DICTIONARYVAR, DBCOLOR, linked PDF UNDERLAY/definition, one LTYPE, a linked TEXTSTYLE/DIMSTYLE table-row pair, and one WIPEOUT, one raw-route ACDBPLACEHOLDER, one version-2 GEODATA, one LAYOUT and one raw ENTITIES custom record, one typed XRECORD, and a text MULTILEADER with a nested leader root/line and named MLEADERSTYLE/TEXTSTYLE dependency plus a block-content MULTILEADER linked to its block record and block-content MLEADERSTYLE, a generated legacy three-row TABLESTYLE and one rich CELLSTYLEMAP cell style, and current/legacy dynamic-constraint DIMENSION profiles alongside all seven standard typed DIMENSION subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT in the whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation failure sweep.

commonFields.construction: Typed DRW_* dimension records serialized in the existing generated whole-operation drawing

allocationSweep.ascii: 1184/1184 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed, including CELLSTYLEMAP and its resolved TEXTSTYLE dependency, and DIMSTYLE with a group-340 handle resolved to the generated TEXTSTYLE row; WIPEOUT callback/readback verifies a valid remapped handle, image-plane vectors and size, four-vertex clip boundary, enabled R2010+ clip mode, and brightness/contrast/fade. ACDBPLACEHOLDER is intentionally delivered through the raw-only route; its exact group-5 handle and group-330 owner pair pass readback. Block-content MULTILEADER and MLEADERSTYLE callbacks resolve their remapped BLOCK_RECORD target and preserve block placement fields, the 16-value transform, and two nested roots, their ordered lines, a root break pair, and a leader-line break pair.
allocationSweep.binary: 1160/1160 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed, including CELLSTYLEMAP and its resolved TEXTSTYLE dependency, and DIMSTYLE with a group-340 handle resolved to the generated TEXTSTYLE row; WIPEOUT callback/readback verifies a valid remapped handle, image-plane vectors and size, four-vertex clip boundary, enabled R2010+ clip mode, and brightness/contrast/fade. ACDBPLACEHOLDER is intentionally delivered through the raw-only route; its exact group-5 handle and group-330 owner pair pass readback. Block-content MULTILEADER and MLEADERSTYLE callbacks resolve their remapped BLOCK_RECORD target and preserve block placement fields, the 16-value transform, and two nested roots, their ordered lines, a root break pair, and a leader-line break pair.

validation.readback: Exactly one callback was delivered for each of the seven standard subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION, LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, RTEXT and ARCALIGNEDTEXT, plus two MULTILEADER callbacks (text and block content), LINE, 3DLINE, RAY, XLINE, SOLID, TRACE, 3DFACE, LIGHT, CAMERA and VIEW, two GEOPOSITIONMARKER profiles, SECTIONOBJECT, MPOLYGON, VIEWPORT, OLE2FRAME, OLEFRAME, SHAPE, RASTERVARIABLES, DICTIONARYVAR, DBCOLOR, PDFUNDERLAY, PDFDEFINITION and one LTYPE, one DIMSTYLE and one generated typed XRECORD selected by payload among multiple XRECORDs. The 3DFACE callback verifies all four generated corners and invisible-edge mask through direct `write3dface()`. The CELLSTYLEMAP callback verifies one generated rich cell style, including identity, content alignment/height, border data, and a remapped text-style handle resolving to the expected named TEXTSTYLE. A separate standalone VIEW callback verifies the remapped non-null identity, name, size, center, target, lens, twist, mode and camera-plottable flag, alongside the CAMERA-linked VIEW. The UCS callback verifies its non-null emitted handle, name, origin/axes/elevation, compatibility orthographic origin and both ordered orthographic option tuples. The custom APPID callback verifies one row with the generated name, a non-null remapped handle and flags. The VPORT projection verifies a generated `*ACTIVE` row and a named row, including the latter's remapped handle, center, snap/grid basis, target, height, ratio and twist. The LINE callback verifies group-8 names the generated custom LAYER; the layer callback/readback checks its remapped identity, name, color, linetype and lineweight. The legacy TABLESTYLE callback verifies the custom text-style name, three row heights/colors, and six ordered border records per row through direct `writeTableStyle()`. The XRECORD group 1 string, group 90 integer, custom-dictionary parent and named dictionary entry match; MULTILEADER callback, closed context, generated text/base/location/height, root metadata and three ordered line points match; the entity style handle resolves to the generated named MLEADERSTYLE, whose group-342 TEXTSTYLE handle resolves to the generated custom TEXTSTYLE; dictionary membership for the style is read back; both dynamic-constraint DIMENSION profiles are delivered through the linear-dimension callback; the legacy layer spelling is emitted/read back normalized as `*ADSK_CONSTRAINTS`, with labels, modeled points and all twelve DSTYLE overrides retained. Common text/style fields and subtype-specific WCS/OCS geometry match typed profiles; large radial chord, overridden center, jog point and group-40 jog angle match; tolerance style, text, insertion, extrusion and axis match; RTEXT style, position, height, rotation, flags, text and extrusion match; arc-aligned text geometry, font names, D2T fields, color, flags and text match; direct 3DLINE/RAY/XLINE/SOLID/TRACE entry points preserve typed geometry; LIGHT fields match; CAMERA-to-VIEW remapping closes; both GeoPositionMarker outer profiles match, and the enabled profile retains embedded MTEXT text/geometry; SECTIONOBJECT and MPOLYGON fields and variable vertex paths match; VIEWPORT paper dimensions, status/id, center, target, view height, snap/grid spacing and stylesheet match; both locally generated OLE frame payloads and OLE2 frame metadata match typed readback; SHAPE DXF-visible style and geometry match; RASTERVARIABLES fields match; DICTIONARYVAR schema/value, parent and named root membership match; DBCOLOR RGB/ACI/book fields, parent and named root membership match; UNDERLAY reference resolves to the PDF definition and both clip paths and modeled fields match; LTYPE description, dash path, size and length match. The DIMSTYLE callback verifies its remapped identity, generated TEXTSTYLE target through group 340, dimpost, scale, arrow size, text height, decimal precision and angular precision. The GEODATA callback verifies one generated version-2 object, host-block handle, design/reference points, coordinate-system definition and RSS tag. The LAYOUT record is emitted through `writeLayout()` and fresh readback checks its custom dictionary membership, handle, name, tab order, flags, paper dimensions/size, limits and stylesheet. The generated opaque custom ENTITY is emitted through `writeRawDxfEntity()`; fresh readback verifies its raw identity, model-space owner and selected payload groups. The WIPEOUT callback verifies its remapped identity, image-plane vectors and size, clipping state and polygon, clip mode, brightness, contrast and fade. ACDBPLACEHOLDER readback is intentionally raw-only; the bounded groups contain exactly handle D97C and owner D914, with the parent target preserved. No typed DXF callback is claimed. The second block-content MULTILEADER has an independent style; both its context and style block references resolve to the remapped generated BLOCK_RECORD containing POINT and ATTDEF, and block placement fields, 16-value transform, and two roots, a root break pair, a leader-line break pair, and their ordered line points match.

limitations: This verifies allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF roundtrip only; it does not qualify native entity presentation or producer-specific DWG semantics.

The CAMERA graph proof covers one generated VIEW record and one handle role; broader VIEW dependencies and producer variants remain open. The standalone VIEW transaction covers one generated no-reference profile only; optional UCS, background, visual-style, sun and live-section references and native view semantics remain open. The UCS transaction covers one generated profile and two orthographic tuples; producer-specific orthographic restoration, UCS name collation and native view behavior remain unqualified. The APPID transaction covers one locally generated row only; broader name domains, extended-data dependency closure and consumer behavior remain open. The VPORT transaction covers one generated `*ACTIVE` plus named-row profile only; group-91 type semantics, optional references and native viewport behavior remain open under P5-H. The LAYER/entity transaction proves one generated name reference and row only; other layer resource references and native layer display remain unqualified.
SECTIONOBJECT's nonzero section-settings handle route and raw-only color domain are not covered.
MPOLYGON associative boundary handles and edge/spline paths are not covered.
VIEWPORT optional reference roles (background, shade plot, clip boundary, UCS, visual style and sun) are not covered.
The OLE payload byte strings are locally generated opaque transaction probes, not valid application-authored embedded OLE documents or consumer qualification.
The SHAPE probe covers its DXF-visible fields only; SHAPE's DWG glyph index and SHAPEFILE relationship are not represented by this DXF profile.
RASTERVARIABLES transaction coverage does not qualify its ACAD_IMAGE_VARS named-object-dictionary edge or raster consumer behavior.
DICTIONARYVAR and DBCOLOR root membership and parent readback are checked, but the encoded owner/pointer role is not independently inspected in this control.
The UNDERLAY pair verifies the entity's definition handle target and typed readback; it does not qualify named underlay dictionary membership or native PDF display.

The TABLESTYLE transaction covers only the generated legacy three-row profile; R24 rich-cell profiles and native table appearance are not covered. The CELLSTYLEMAP transaction covers one locally generated rich cell-style profile and its TEXTSTYLE reference resolution; it is not independent wire/source-profile, producer interoperability, TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP graph-closure, or native table-presentation evidence. The LTYPE test covers serialization transaction and DXF typed fields only; it does not implement LibreCAD PR #3269's adapter-side comparison of edited LC_LineType definitions against archived DRW_LType records. PR #3269 merged independently into LibreCAD master on 2026-11-13; that application-side behavior is outside this libdxfrw plan and is not an outstanding libdxfrw implementation item. The generated TEXTSTYLE/DIMSTYLE pair proves one generated STYLE payload and one group-340 dependency under allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF readback; it does not qualify other DIMSTYLE variable combinations, legacy-version downgrades, optional arrow/linetype resources, producer interoperability or native dimension rendering. The WIPEOUT profile is generated transaction/readback coverage only; optional image-definition/reactor references and native masking behavior remain unqualified.
The GEODATA whole-operation control verifies the local generated profile only; producer interoperability and native georeferencing semantics remain unqualified.

The generated LAYOUT transaction uses a custom dictionary owner and proves local writer rollback/readback only; canonical ACAD_LAYOUT ownership, reference closure, producer interoperability and native plotting remain unqualified.
The raw ENTITY control is a locally generated opaque custom type and proves raw writer rollback/replay only; it does not establish semantic support or producer interoperability.

The typed XRECORD control uses a generated profile and verifies allocation rollback/retry, its two typed payload values and dictionary graph edge only; it is not independent source-profile, producer interoperability or consumer semantic evidence.

The MULTILEADER transaction covers generated text-content and block-content contexts, a two-root block-content profile with one root break pair and one leader-line break pair, plus generated style references; broader producer profiles, larger graphs, and native consumer semantics are not covered. The linked generated MLEADERSTYLE/TEXTSTYLE profile proves local transaction and handle closure only, not physical producer profiles or native annotation behavior.

The dynamic-constraint DIMENSION controls use generated generic profiles for current and legacy layer spellings and all twelve modeled DSTYLE overrides; they verify rollback/retry, normalization and typed field readback only. Native constraint evaluation, display, and independent physical group-70 absence inspection are not covered.

Other custom or dynamic DIMENSION profiles beyond the two generated constraint cases, custom subclasses beyond ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION, and broader public writer profiles remain outside this control.
No full test suite was run.
ACDBPLACEHOLDER uses an intentional raw-only DXF read route; this transaction proves its output handle and owner groups but is not typed DXF parser/callback semantic evidence.

fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; all drawings and data profiles are generated locally by the test in scratch storage.
